Tired of getting auto-rejections?

The job market isn't broken—the aggregators are. Here is why applying directly on company career pages changes the game:

LinkedIn / Indeed Aggregators
  • ✕ "Posted 1 hour ago, over 200 applicants." Unfair competition from automated spam bots.
  • ✕ Low interview reply rates. Resumes disappear into an unread ATS black hole.
  • ✕ Advertised jobs = Low quality jobs. Only desperate roles pay thousands to advertise.
  • ✕ Recruiter agency fees. Third-party recruiters take 20-30% cuts of hiring budgets.
  • ✕ Ghost jobs. Stale listings kept open forever just to harvest talent databases.
Average response rate: less than 3%
Direct Advantage
Career Hound Source Code
  • ✓ Less competition. You are often among the first 10 direct applicants.
  • ✓ High reply rate for interviews. Hiring teams actively prioritize direct portal submissions.
  • ✓ Jobs that aren't advertised. Discover real headcount companies didn't pay to promote.
  • ✓ Apply directly to the hiring team. No recruiter gatekeeping or hidden commission hurdles.
  • ✓ Verified real jobs. Automatically validated active ATS boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby).
Average response rate: 4.2x higher interview conversion
